title: Simulation 3D Trailer
text: Implement trailer in 3D environment, 2 inputs, {Type} sets Trailer type Two-axle; {Name}, {Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} sets the vehicle initial translation zeros, {Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} sets the vehicle initial rotation zeros and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type
params.values: Trailer type Two-axle trailer (default) | Three-axle trailer | One-axle trailer

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of vehicle SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
params.values: Vehicle initial translation zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | zeros( 7, 3 ) | zeros( 3, 3 )

params.name: Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
params.values: Vehicle initial rotation zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | zeros( 7, 3 ) | zeros( 3, 3 )
